verdict.rationale: Segment's documented Public API supports CRUD on workspace resources, explicitly including Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans. It ships with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, SDKs, token authentication, rate-limit, pagination and versioning docs, so an agent can programmatically create and manage pipeline resources. missing for 10: explicit evidence of wiring/connecting sources to destinations via the API, evidence of inspecting event deliveries or delivery metrics programmatically, an official MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
